rules.name: CSR Funding Prohibited vs Permitted
rules.reason: Draft prohibits CSR funding whereas the referenced GR explicitly permits CSR funding.

rules.name: Funding Ratio Contradiction
rules.reason: Draft specifies a funding ratio of 50:50, while the referenced GR mandates a 60:40 share.
rules.recommendation: Align state and central funding ratios with matching GR guidelines.

rules.name: District Collector vs Ministry Level Approval
rules.reason: Draft delegates approval authority to the District Collector, whereas the referenced GR mandates Ministry/Secretary level approval.
rules.recommendation: Verify approval authority levels with the General Administration Department guidelines.

rules.name: Completion Timeline Discrepancy
rules.reason: Draft clause specifies a 30-day completion timeline, whereas the existing GR allows 90 days for the same process.
rules.recommendation: Ensure timeline consistency across procedural requirements.

rules.name: Committee Size Contradiction
rules.reason: Draft specifies a 3-member committee composition, whereas the reference GR mandates a 5-member committee.
rules.recommendation: Check Maharashtra MoOP committee standards for member composition.

rules.name: Conflicting Act Version
rules.reason: Draft cites the outdated 1999 version of the Act, while the active GR references the 2015 Amendment.
rules.recommendation: Update the draft to reference the latest amended version of the Act.

rules.name: Nodal Department Discrepancy
rules.reason: Draft claims Higher & Technical Education department as the nodal authority, contradicting the reference GR naming School Education department.
rules.recommendation: Clarify the department jurisdiction with GAD circulars.
